note: Historical results are quoted as stored. Nothing here edits them. 'reproducibility' states what was independently verified in this study.

experiments.research_question: Do global learned models beat seasonal baselines for 28-day-ahead daily unit demand of sparse retail series?
experiments.intended_claim: Boosted trees reduce per-series WAPE relative to seasonal naive; ensembles add nothing. (Exploratory single-window result.)

dataset.name: M5 Forecasting Accuracy, store CA_1, seeded 350-series department-stratified subset
dataset.source: Zenodo record 12636070 (files of the M5 competition); licence label cc-by-4.0 set by the uploader, NOT independently verified against the competition rules
dataset.eligibility: first sale on or before day 1100

experiments.target: units_sold (non-negative integers); 48.7% zeros in the test window
experiments.features: lags H..H+28 (weekly steps), rolling mean 7/28/84, rolling std 28, non-zero share 28, days since last sale, same-weekday mean of 4 lags, calendar, event flag, SNAP flag, selling price + 3 price-derived features, department/category/item codes
experiments.feature_availability: history features use days <= origin (t - H); calendar, event, SNAP and selling price are published in advance

split.scheme: chronological; 3 validation windows of 28 days then one untouched 28-day test window

experiments.horizon: 28 days, direct strategy, single forecast origin (day 1913)
experiments.hyperparameter_selection: fixed 2-variant grid per family; variant chosen per family by mean WAPE on the 3 validation origins; test scored once

metrics.mae: mean(|forecast - actual|) over all (series, day) points; units of the target
metrics.wape: sum|forecast - actual| / sum(actual); None when sum(actual) = 0 (never reported as 0)
metrics.bias: sum(forecast - actual) / sum(actual) (relative bias; positive = over-forecast); None when sum(actual) = 0
metrics.rmsse_mean: per series sqrt(mean e^2 / mean((y_t - y_{t-1})^2 over TRAINING history)); unweighted mean over series; constant-history series excluded and counted
metrics.aggregate_daily_wape: WAPE after summing all series per day (store-day aggregate level); NOT comparable with per-series WAPE
metrics.median_series_wape: median over series of per-series WAPE (series with sum(actual) > 0)

experiments.uncertainty: paired series-cluster bootstrap of WAPE differences (2000 draws, seed 42); resamples series only
warnings_and_limitations: one forecast origin: results are conditional on a single 28-day window
series-cluster bootstrap ignores cross-sectional dependence through shared calendar days and store-level shocks
one store, 350 of the eligible series: no hierarchy, no between-store generalisation

experiments.research_question: Same protocol as E1 on one real retailer's total revenue and its 20 top SKUs.
experiments.intended_claim: Exploratory: learned models vs baselines on small real series.

dataset.name: UCI Online Retail II (one UK online gift retailer)
dataset.licence: CC BY 4.0 (stated on the UCI page)
dataset.cleaning: drop cancellations, non-positive quantity or price, 15 non-product stock codes, exact duplicate lines (counts stored in the run)

targets.top20_sku_daily_units: 20 series, 560 test points; SKUs chosen by revenue BEFORE the first validation origin

experiments.features: same builder as E1 with price/availability and department/category columns dropped; calendar flags incl. Christmas closure window

split.scheme: chronological; 3 validation windows then the final 28 days

metrics.mae: mean(|forecast - actual|) over all (series, day) points; units of the target
metrics.wape: sum|forecast - actual| / sum(actual); None when sum(actual) = 0 (never reported as 0)
metrics.bias: sum(forecast - actual) / sum(actual) (relative bias; positive = over-forecast); None when sum(actual) = 0
metrics.aggregate_daily_wape: WAPE after summing all series per day (store-day aggregate level); NOT comparable with per-series WAPE
metrics.median_series_wape: median over series of per-series WAPE (series with sum(actual) > 0)

experiments.uncertainty: series-cluster bootstrap for the 20-SKU task only; none for the single series
warnings_and_limitations: 28 test points for the revenue series: no inference possible

experiments.research_question: How well do classifiers rank customers who will make no purchase in the next 90 days?
experiments.intended_claim: Exploratory ranking performance and calibration on a PROXY label.

dataset.name: UCI Online Retail II customers with a Customer ID
dataset.label: no invoice in the 90 days after a cutoff (inactivity); NOT observed churn

split.scheme: temporal snapshots: train cutoffs 2010-06-01, 2010-09-01, 2010-12-01, 2011-03-14; validation 2011-06-12; test 2011-09-10; 90-day label windows non-overlapping and ordered

experiments.hyperparameter_selection: fixed configurations; calibrators (sigmoid, isotonic) and thresholds (F1-max, cost-min) fitted on the validation snapshot only

metrics.brier: mean squared error of the score as a probability
metrics.ece: expected calibration error, 10 equal-width bins on [0,1] (ml/benchmark/churn.py ece)

warnings_and_limitations: the same customers appear in several snapshots (temporal, not group-disjoint, split)
no stored predictions: metrics cannot be recomputed without a rerun
thresholded accuracy is not stored (derivable from stored confusion counts)
assumed costs (FP 1, FN 3) for the cost threshold

experiments.research_question: Same classifiers on the synthetic platform churn file.

dataset.name: data/platform/churn/customers.csv
dataset.label: drawn from a known logistic mechanism (generator seed recorded in the data metadata)

limitations: the label is a function of the features by construction: the result measures how well a model recovers the generator, not customer behaviour
an earlier c2 run (c2_20261015T073608Z_4598ea68) used columns production excludes and is SUPERSEDED (kept, not used)

experiments.research_question: Is a price response identifiable in M5 and in the platform data, and do the models imply one?
experiments.claim_type: NOT a prediction benchmark: fixed-effects association + model counterfactual sweeps

experiments.research_question: Recompute the earlier provisional baselines (registry metrics, model comparison) from original files.

reproducibility.note: software versions differ from the original runs; the run records any non-zero difference as is

experiments.research_question: One-day-ahead daily revenue of one real Indian local store: do learned models beat a seasonal naive baseline?
experiments.hyperparameter_selection: lowest mean expanding-window CV RMSE (3 folds) among 4 learned models; test unused
limitations: 12 test days: any ranking is unstable
exclusion rule removes 34,046 of 94,290 lines (qty<=0, non-integer qty, amount mismatch)

reproducibility.rerun: reproduce run recomputed it with max |diff| 0.0

limitations: synthetic generator; results describe the generator

experiments.research_question: How do the product's own forecasting methods do in a chronological own-history backtest on real public retail series?
limitations: a handful of overlapping origins; coverage is dependent

experiments.metrics_recorded: forecast: MAE, RMSE, MAPE; churn: precision, recall, F1 (default 0.5 cut-off), ROC-AUC
limitations: the churn label is generated from recency and tenure, which are also features
no PR-AUC, calibration, confusion matrix, baseline MAE or sample counts recorded

experiments.status: no stored result on any real business
experiments.detail: forecast_validation_service (own-history rolling-origin backtest) and customer-score validation exist and are tested; the development database holds 0 forecast_eval and 0 customer_eval runs and 0 outcome observations.
